title: RDS instance event subscriptions to Amazon SNS
description: RDS instance event subscriptions for failure, low storage and availability events

introBox.headline: How it works
text: RDS event subscriptions allow users to configure notifications for RDS events (provided through an SNS topic). This template configures an event subscription for failure, low storage, and availability event categories for RDS Instances.
